45template <class Message, class Handler>
46bool receiveNext(CommunicationHandler &comms, const std::string &queueName,
47 std::chrono::milliseconds timeout,
48 const std::atomic<bool> &terminationFlag, Handler &&handle) {
49 auto received = comms.receive<Message>(queueName, timeout, terminationFlag);
50 if (!received) {
51 spdlog::warn("Could not read from queue '{}': {}", queueName,
52 received.error().detail);
53 return false;
54 }
55 if (!received->has_value()) {
56 return false;
57 }
58 std::invoke(std::forward<Handler>(handle), std::move(**received));
59 return true;
60}

72template <class Message, class Handler>
73bool drainQueue(CommunicationHandler &comms, const std::string &queueName,
74 const std::atomic<bool> &terminationFlag, Handler &&handle) {
75 bool handledAny = false;
76 // A single non-blocking poll per turn: the queue is drained by looping,
77 // not by waiting, so an empty queue costs one round trip rather than a
78 // timeout.
79 while (receiveNext<Message>(comms, queueName, std::chrono::milliseconds(0),
80 terminationFlag, handle)) {
81 handledAny = true;
82 }
83 return handledAny;
84}

95template <class Message>
96void send(CommunicationHandler &comms, const Message &message,
97 const std::string &queueName) {
98 if (auto sent = comms.send(message, queueName); !sent) {
99 spdlog::warn("{}", sent.error().detail);
100 }
101}

109inline void sendFailure(CommunicationHandler &comms,
110 const mqss::QuantumTask &task, const Error &failure,
111 std::string_view stage) {
112 send(comms, cancelQuantumTask(task, failure.detail),
113 task.result_destination());
114 spdlog::warn("Task {} {} [{}]: {}", task.task_id(), stage,
115 toString(failure.kind), failure.detail);
116}
117
122inline void sendResult(CommunicationHandler &comms,
123 const mqss::QuantumTask &task,
124 const mqss::QuantumResult &result) {
125 send(comms, result, task.result_destination());
126 spdlog::info("Job Executed successfully. Results for task {} sent to '{}'.",
127 task.task_id(), task.result_destination());
128}
